title: fix(app-shell): New automation never saves a typed prefix as the trigger object
body:
Refs #30038 (items 1, 2, 4)

Item 3 (the closure refusal on 问题 reads in English) does not land here: the text is produced server-side by `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts:513`, outside this card's `ui/**` lane. It is listed in the report for the seat to carry. The card stays open for it.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新建自动化对话框里的「对象」选择框只接受真实对象;输入前缀按 Enter,只剩一个匹配就选它,否则提示「未选择对象」,不再把半截文字存成触发对象。
- 为什么改:运营人员像用搜索框一样按 Enter,结果流程绑到不存在的对象上,事后才在「问题」里看到英文报错。
- 风险与回滚:只在新建自动化对话框这两处开启(新的可选开关 `objectsOnly`);其他用到该选择框的地方(流程引用可填表达式)行为不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx`(`commitTyped` 一段)、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(两处 `objectsOnly`)、`ObjectPicker.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.createTaken-26917.test.tsx`,预期 25 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ObjectPicker` gains an opt-in prop `objectsOnly` (default off). With it, Enter and blur never commit the typed text as itself. They commit the pickable object named exactly so, else the only pickable option left in the filtered list, else no object (an empty commit), and the picker shows a `role="alert"` line: "No object chosen: "TEXT" is not an object. Choose one from the list." Options outside the package closure stay unpickable, as before. Before the catalog is read, nothing can be resolved and the typed text is committed as before.
- The New automation dialog (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) turns `objectsOnly` on for both trigger-object pickers: the record preset and the Advanced trigger form. With a record preset and no object chosen, Create keeps the dialog open with the existing "Choose the object it watches." line.
- Every other `ObjectPicker` use is unchanged. `FlowReferenceField.tsx` (an object-kind flow reference, where an expression is legal) passes no `objectsOnly` and keeps free text.
- zh/en strings in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`: `engine.inspector.objectPicker.notChosen` and `engine.inspector.objectPicker.noMatchObjectsOnly`. The default empty-list line ("Press Enter to keep what you typed") would mislead at an objects-only door.

## Tests

- `ObjectPicker.test.tsx`, new top-level describe "objectsOnly": a one-match prefix + Enter commits the match; a several-match prefix + Enter commits nothing and shows the refusal; a non-object name clears a chosen value on Enter and on blur; a full name commits as itself; and, without `objectsOnly`, the same one-match prefix is committed as typed (item 2).
- `StudioDesignSurface.createTaken-26917.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (the shared New-automation harness): with the "updated" record preset, prefix `tick` + Enter + Create saves a Start node with `objectName: 'acme_ticket'`; prefix `acme` (two matches) + Enter + Create saves nothing, shows the refusal and "Choose the object it watches.", and the dialog stays open (item 1 at the door).


</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD after each leg)</summary>

- Leg A, `ObjectPicker.tsx`: `if (!objectsOnly || catalog.status !== 'loaded') {` replaced with `if (true) {` (objectsOnly ignored). Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob e2118e0a8872 to 53ef6e70092f). Result: 5 failed, 20 passed. The three objectsOnly picker cases and both door cases went red; the full-name case and the free-text (item 2) case stayed green, as they should. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg B, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the record preset's `objectsOnly` replaced with `objectsOnly={false}`. Mutation landed (blob fc99d66e24c9 to b3f8845a7e8e). Result: 2 failed, 8 passed, both door cases red. Restored: blob == HEAD. The first attempt at this leg used a replacement already inside the anchor; the tool refused it as a no-op before running anything, and the anchor was changed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Item 3 is not here. The refusal is the `message` of a `packages/lint` finding (`validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts:513`, rule `FLOW_TRIGGER_UNKNOWN_OBJECT`). It is English prose with `objectName` and the package id written into it, and no structured parameters a ui renderer could localize from. Localizing it means a producer-side change (structured params or a code the Console keys on), outside this lane.
- With this fix, the reported route (prefix + Enter + Save as draft) no longer creates a flow bound to a non-object, so this reader no longer reaches that refusal from this door.

## Verification

Local gates, derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` from the merge base and reconciled with `--ran`. Exit codes are in the report. CI runs the full set.
